item.text: {"search_note":"I found no reliable 2024 evidence of any nuclear custody, weapons-safety, or accident-prevention program under Tshisekedi, which is unsurprising given the available public record. So for this lens, the evidence is entirely indirect and mostly about conventional military discipline, not nuclear command-and-control. Best-supported judgment: some effort to tighten discipline, but no convincing evidence of broadly strengthened command-and-control safety safeguards, and several strong indicators of ongoing dysfunction.","evidence":[{"title":"Le Chef de L'état a présidé le Conseil supérieur de la défense","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-02-05","url":"https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/le_chef_de_l_etat_a_preside_le_conseil_superieur_de_la_defense","summary":"Tshisekedi convened the Supreme Defense Council to review military and operational issues in North Kivu. The council also asked him to lift the death-penalty moratorium for treason within the defense and security forces, which is evidence of a harder line on discipline.","question_ids":["1B.3"]},{"title":"Sécurité à l’Est: le Chef de l’État a réuni la Task force du Haut commandement militaire","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-07-05","url":"https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/securite_a_lest_le_chef_de_letat_a_reuni_la_task_force_du_haut_commandement_militaire","summary":"Tshisekedi held the first meeting of a military high-command task force, received tactical assessments, and ordered the high command to launch actions to safeguard territorial integrity. This is direct, if limited, evidence of command oversight.","question_ids":["1B.3"]},{"title":"Sécurité dans l’Est: le Chef de L’Etat a présidé la deuxième réunion de la Task force du haut commandement militaire","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-07-09","url":"https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/securite_dans_lest_le_chef_de_l_etat_a_preside_la_deuxieme_reunion_de_la_task_force_du_haut_commandement_militaire","summary":"Tshisekedi chaired a second task-force meeting with defense, security, and finance officials to evaluate the eastern military situation and ordered implementation of measures decided to preserve territorial integrity. This supports the view that he was actively managing command coordination.","question_ids":["1B.3"]},{"title":"Congo lifts moratorium on death penalty, justice ministry circular shows","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-03-15","url":"https://www.yahoo.com/news/congo-lifts-moratorium-death-penalty-153836346.html","summary":"Reuters reported that Congo lifted its death-penalty moratorium, citing treachery and espionage in recurring armed conflicts and saying the justice ministry framed the move as a way to rid the army of traitors and curb terrorism and banditry. That is evidence of a stricter discipline posture, though it is also a rights concern.","question_ids":["1B.3"]},{"title":"DR Congo soldiers sentenced to death for fleeing battle","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-07-04","url":"https://theprint.in/world/dr-congo-soldiers-sentenced-to-death-for-fleeing-battle/2160344/","summary":"Reuters reported that a military tribunal sentenced 25 soldiers to death for theft, fleeing the enemy, and violating orders, while noting earlier death sentences for cowardice. This is the clearest evidence that the administration enforced harsh discipline inside the armed forces.","question_ids":["1B.3"]},{"title":"Democratic Republic of Congo army says it stopped attempted coup","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-05-19","url":"https://theprint.in/world/democratic-republic-of-congo-army-says-it-stopped-attempted-coup/2091958/","summary":"Armed men attacked the presidency complex and briefly occupied an office in the seat of power before security forces stopped the coup attempt. This is negative evidence: it shows a serious failure of custody and command security around the presidency.","question_ids":["1B.3"]},{"title":"Army disarray hobbles Congo's fight with Rwanda-backed rebels, officers say","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-07-17","url":"https://theprint.in/world/army-disarray-hobbles-congos-fight-with-rwanda-backed-rebels-officers-say/2160048/","summary":"Reuters said senior officers described mismanagement, inexperienced and demoralized troops, poor logistics, and over-reliance on proxies. That is strong counterevidence against a claim that Tshisekedi had strengthened disciplined command-and-control in practice.","question_ids":["1B.3"]},{"title":"At least nine killed in strike on displacement camp in eastern Congo","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-05-03","url":"https://www.yahoo.com/news/airstrike-kills-nine-displacement-camp-110342393.html","summary":"Nine civilians, including seven children, were killed in a strike on a displacement camp near Goma; Reuters said it was not immediately clear what weapon was used or who was responsible. This does not prove deliberate command failure by Tshisekedi, but it is relevant negative context for safety and accident-prevention performance in the security environment.","question_ids":["1B.3"]}]}
